posts.text: Maple holds 225 million XRP worth 280M USD as collateral in its syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT loans, backing 151.8M USD of stablecoin debt issued from Ethereum pools but custodied on XRPL. Three positions mature between December and January, with collateral ratios above 178%.
